text: {"claims": [{"text": "I am a certified Kubernetes administrator.", "supported_by": []}, {"text": "I built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over 4,000 product manuals using Python, FastAPI and pgvector.", "supported_by": ["b4"]}, {"text": "During my time as a Machine Learning Intern at Brightcart Retail Analytics, I built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over 4,000 product manuals using Python, FastAPI, and pgvector.", "supported_by": ["b3", "b4"]}, {"text": "By tuning chunk size and prompts based on an evaluation set of 150 questions, I raised answer accuracy from 71% to 86%.", "supported_by": ["b5"]}, {"text": "I also containerised the service with Docker and deployed it on a company virtual machine.", "supported_by": ["b6"]}, {"text": "Additionally, my technical toolkit includes proficiency in Python, JavaScript, SQL, C++, and PostgreSQL, alongside hands-on experience with Docker and Git.", "supported_by": ["b12", "b14"]}, {"text": "In my project StudyBuddy, I developed an application using Python, the Gemini API, and React that generates flashcards from uploaded PDFs with structured JSON output validated by Pydantic, which was used by 120 classmates during end-semester exams.", "supported_by": ["b7", "b8", "b9"]}, {"text": "My ability to design structured data solutions and build dependable software is further demonstrated by my recognition as a finalist in the Smart India Hackathon 2025.", "supported_by": ["b15"]}]}
